tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i rnam thar 'bring po byin rlabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhaṭṭa ra ka saṅgu ru dharmā swa mi badzra a tsarya mahā gu ṇa ratna ka raḥbuddha dhwa dza ye na maḥ bod skad du/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje rdo rje slob dpon chen po yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag dpal ldan he ru ka /zhing 'dir ngur smrig gos kyis mdzes pa'i yongs 'dzin mus pa rje/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol mdzad bka' drin can/ /khyed la shes nas dad pas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyobs/ /dam pa gang gi ngo mtshar rnam thar tshogs/ /rgyas par logs su bshad mod de lta na'ang / /'dir ni nyung gsal 'bring du bstan pa yis/ /byin rlabs dgos 'dod kun 'byung bshad kyi nyon/ /'dir bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ srid pa gsum gyi bla ma/ sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mig gcig pu/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa 'di ni/ nges pa kho nar bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ro mnyam pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du mdzad zin kyang / gdul bya gzhan gyi ngor nam yang zab mo chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du de'i gzugs kyis sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa mchog dang mchog ma yin pa'i sgo nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing las 'dod dgu mtha' dag 'byung ba'am/

nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa tshon sna tshogs pa dang 'phrad na de dang de'i kha dog mdzes pa 'dzin pa ji lta ba bzhin gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang / bsam pa dang / dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i gang zag tu nges pa las/ 'dir ni so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul bzung bar snang ste/ de ltar yang rje sa paṇa gyis/ khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas/ /gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin la/ des na kho bo cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'di nyid gzhan don du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul dang / mchog gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul gyi rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/ de yang dang po ni phyogs gang du dus nam gyi tshe 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan snyam na/ bod 'dir sa'i cha gsum du gnas pa las/ bar gyi cha/ de la yang ru bzhir grags pa las g.yas ru'i khongs su gtogs pa/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong ba'i mnga' 'og dol smad ces bya ba'i 'brog sib tu/ mi'u rigs bzhi las ldong gi rus 'dzin pa/ yab shangs pa chos skyong bkra shis bya ba bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad cing sems can la snying rje che ba/ lugs gnyis la mkhyen pa rgyas pa zhig dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan rtags dang ldan pa'i stod mtsho ma rtog gzungs skyabs ma zhes bya ba dad pa dang snying rje che zhing dkon mchog gi zhabs tog la brtson pa zhig gi sras su/ dus ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa lung gi dus/ mdo sde spyod pa nas lo brgya phrag gcig dang bcu phrag brgyad dang nyag ma bzhi 'das pa'i lnga pa'i steng du sleb pa/ dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i gza' tshes bzang po'i nyin bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di nyid bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas mngal gyi dri mas ma gos bzhin du phru ma sgom thag gi tshul du byas nas yum la gnod pa med par bde bar bltams shing /

lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe na'ang yum la rmi ltas bzang po du ma dang / nyin bar gyi tshe yang shes pa gsal zhing bde bas brgyan pa dang / lus ldang ba yangs shing zo mdog bde ba la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rtags khyad par can du ma byung bar mngon no/ /de lta bu'i dam pa'i skyes bu gzhon nu de ni gzugs bzang mdzes la blta na sdug pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar zhing zlum pa/ shangs gzengs mtho ba dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing / spyan utpal ltar bkra ba/ kun gyi yid du 'ong ba zhig go /zhes thos la/ de nas yab yum rnams kyis dga' mgu yid rang ba dang bcas mtshan khro bo rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar btags so/ /'dir smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi ye shes nyid/ /lha mi'i bsod nams mgron du nyer 'phos te/ /ngo mtshar yon tan zer gyi drwa ba can/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog 'di shar bar gyur/ /snyigs dus sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar grags pa'i/ /mtshan tsam thos pas srid zhi yi/ /rgud pa sel 'di e ma mtshar// ༈ //gnyis pa mchog gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad pa la don bcu gsum gyis sgo nas bstan par bya ste/ byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das shing theg chen gyi rigs sad pa sogs chos kyi bag chags bzang po mngon du gyur pa'i tshul/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs shing rten de la bslab sbyangs mdzad pa'i tshul/ mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma las gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i tshul/ thos bsam sgom pa la gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor ba gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgo nas nan tan snying por mdzad pa'i tshul/ dben par sgom sgrub la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul/ bzang po'i yon tan las 'phros te sa bcu'i byang sems chen po buddha ratna'i rnam par sprul par gdon mi za ba'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa dang ldan pa'i tshul/

'dren pa dam pa'i bka' bzhin bstan pa dang sems can gyi don ci rigs su mdzad pa'i tshul/ slar yang zab mo sgom sgrub la g.yengs med du bzhugs pa'i tshul/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa kun gyi rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol ba'i tshul/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ spros pa thams cad bcad de gcig tu dben pa la gzhol ba'i tshul/ bgrang ba las 'das pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi slob bu'i tshogs bskrun te 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i legs lam la mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams bkod pa'i tshul/ thun mong du snang ba'i gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul gyis 'bras bu mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul sogs don tshan bcu gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i rgyas bshad rnams kho bos logs su byas pa'i rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba las rtogs par bya'o/ /'dir de dag gi snying po bsdus pa'i cha shas mdo tsam zhig brjod na bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po mtshungs pa med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon 'di nyid ni nges pa'i don du khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog gi tshul bzung ba yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa rdzogs par ni rje nyid rang dang spangs rtogs mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas nang phan tshun dag gis rtogs pa dang brjod par nus pa yin gyis/ gzhan sar gnas kyi byang sems dag gis kyang de ltar ma yin na/ bdag lta bu'i so so skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan dag gis brjod par nus pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'on kyang rang nyid mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig ste/

de yang mkhas pa'i tshul ni/ spyir shes bya'i yul thams cad dang / lhag par sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde'i tshogs mu mtha' med pa rnams dang / de'i nang nas kyang rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye gsang gsum yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i rgyud/ rgya gzhung / 'grel pa/ 'grel bshad/ dbang khrid man ngag zhar byung phyag len phra mo tshun la'ang mkhas pa'i mchog dam par dus mtshungs pa'i mkhas shing mkhas par grags pa'i sa skyong chen po rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / rnam dpyod rab tu gsal ba'i skye bo kun gyis mgrin gcig tu 'dzin pa'i yul du gyur pa yin la/ btsun pa'i tshul ni/ so thar gyi bslab tshigs gsum gyis rim pa bzhin thugs rgyud btams pa nas bzung / nyes ltung rags pa rnams kyis lta ci smos/ skye bcad kyi nyes pa tsam gyis kyang ma gos par mdzad pa'i lo rgyus yod la/ tha na bla gos bzhes lugs ma legs pa tsam yang zhabs drung du yun ring du bsdad pa'i skye bo sus kyang mthong ma myong ba yin zhing / dbu lo dang na bza' sogs la'ang tshul khrims kyi dri zhim khyad par can 'byung ba ni kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa 'di yin no/ /byang sems kyi sdom pa bzhes phyin phar gnod pa lta ga la zhig ste/ tshur gnod pa chen po byas pa la yang khong khro ba tsam yang mi mnga' zhing / gnod lan du phan pa kho na bsgrub par mdzad la dus ngan gyi skye bo drin lan log par 'jal ba'i bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gis rje rang gi sku la brdegs pa dang / tshig ngan gyi mtshon bya'i char chen po phab pa la'ang thugs bzod pa chen pos de ma thag bshags pa bzhes pa dang / slar sdang shugs can de dag gi byed pas nged la'ang khong khro skyes nas dge sbyor la gnod par byung bas rang gzhan kun las ngan la sbyar bas shin tu ma legs zhes thugs la khro ba cung zad 'khrungs pa la yang 'gyod pa bzod glags med pa lta bu mdzad cing /

zhal nas kyang sngon gyi thang sku rnams kyi rgyab yig la/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes bris pa 'di chos pa rnams kyi blo la zhog dgos zhes yang yang gsungs so/ /rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa dbang dus su tshul bzhin du thob pa/ lam dus su gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor bas nan tan du srung sdom mdzad pa la brten nas de'i sdom pa'i snying po rim pa gnyis kyi lam la mngon par byang chub ste/ tha mal gyi rtog pa gang gis kyang rdzi bar mi nus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la dbang 'byor pa yin te/ de'i tshul ni rje rang gi gsung las kyang / sngon mar pa lho brag pas paṇa chen nā ro pa'i drung du dbang thob phyin chad nas bzung tha mal rnam rtog gis rdzi ma myong gsungs pa ltar/ sa skya pa'i bla chen gong ma lnga dang / de'i gdung brgyud dri ma med par rim par byon pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bla ma gong ma 'ga' re la de 'dra ba'i rtogs pa 'khrungs 'dug pa bzhin/ nged kyis kyang rje btsun dam pa mkhan chen chos dbang phyug pa sogs la dbang thob nas zhag 'ga' tha mal rnam rtog gis rdzi ma myong zhes gsungs shing / nyams len thams cad sems dang 'dre dgos pa yin pas chos gang nyams su len kyang sems dang bsres nas byed dgos zhes yang yang gsungs la/ dus phyis bdag sogs dad ldan gyi bu slob grangs mi nyung tsam zhabs drung du yod pa'i skabs 'ga' re yang spyan 'bras shangs kyi rtser zim bur gzigs shing ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la mnyam par 'jog pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ de'i ngang la rgyun ring po'i bar 'byams 'gro zhing / slar gzim sgo phye ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis ting nge 'dzin de las sad yong ba yang yang mthong zhing / snga gong nas kyang 'di 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du 'byams pa'i lo rgyus mang po yod la/

bu slob 'ga' zhig la nged la nyams rtogs chen po med kyang ye shes 'jug ldog dum tsam yong gin 'dug ces kyang gsungs 'dug go /de ltar mkhas pa dang btsun pa'i yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag de nyid kyi bzang po'i yon tan mtha' dag lta ci smos/ kho bo rang gi blo ngor shar ba tsam zhig brjod kyang mtha' yas mod/ 'dir mtshon pa tsam zhig brjod na/ spyir rje bla ma 'di nyid ni chos mdzad gzhan gyi lugs ltar bcad rgya la sogs pa'i skabs 'di dang 'dir thugs dam la brtson la/ de las gzhan pa'i 'di dang 'dir mi brtson no zhes pa'i skabs med par dus khor yug tu mtshan gung gi cha la sku khams gso ba'i mnal gyi rnal 'byor cung zad re dang / snga dro dang phyi dro'i thun mtshams gang rigs la gsung rab zab mo'i gzigs rtog gam/ yang chos zhu ba yod tshe rang rang gi chos thun rnams gsungs pa sogs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i skabs rnams ma gtogs pa nyin mtshan khor yug tu thugs dam 'ba' zhig la bzhugs pa yin la/ de la brten nas ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan khyad par can 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/ zab mo'i yang rtse mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor la brten nas sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / 'chi 'pho skye ba len pa'i tshul sgrib med du gzigs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa gzigs pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa'ang thugs la 'khrungs shing lung bstan khyad par can thob pa dang / 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor 'byongs pa'i rtags mtshan mig yod kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa yin te/ de yang rje'i zhal nas/ nged kyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi rin chen bzhi'i bsnyen pa byas nas bzung lus kyi shig rnams med/ da dung khog pa'i nang na srin 'bu cung zad yod tshod du 'dug ces sgrib g.yogs dang bcas gsungs pa dang / bde mchog gi rdzogs rim zab mo dpyid thig gi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu bzhugs skabs sbyin bdag ma zhig 'das nas de'i yar 'dren la spyan drangs pas/

de dus kyi sbyin bdag ma de gang du skye ba sogs shes pa tsam byung gsungs shing / rdzogs rim zab mo dpyid thig la brten nas nyams rtogs khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor la rang dbang thob pa'i rtags ni rje nyid kyi dbu gtsug na dbu thod gzhan las mtho ba'i ting phor sgong zhabs kyi tshad tsam pa'i dbu thod 'bur mo zhig yod pa la/ rje'i gsung las/ nged kyi thod pa 'bur ba 'di rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma de sbyangs pas 'byongs pa'i rtags dod pa yin zhing / gzhan gyis sbyangs na'ang 'di ltar 'ong zhes rje'i dbon po 'ga' zhig la gsungs 'dug pa las brgyud nas thos so/ /yang dpal kyai rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chu bo ma nub par thugs nyams su bzhes pas ngo bo nyid gsum gyi lta ba mthar phyin cing bskyed rim la brtan pa thob ste snang srid tha mal pa 'di lha dang gzhal yas khang du gzigs pa yin te/ rje'i zhal nas kho bos dgon pa rdzong du kyai rdo rje'i lam dus kyi nyams len tshul bzhin byung bar 'dug ste/ gnas der lam dus nyams su blangs skabs/ skabs 'gar dag pa dran pa tsam du sleb pa dang bzhugs khang tshoms kyi snang ba de khrig 'gags nas 'gro ba 'dra yang byung gsungs so/ /yang zab mo ne gu chos drug la brten nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa yin te/ rje'i zhal nas nged kyis rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho ba la ne gu chos drug zhu bzhin pa'i ngang nas bsam gtan phug tu ne gu'i zab lam chos drug so so rnams la chig bsgril du byed pa'i skabs shig na/ nam phyed tsam nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo mtshar can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs nas sang sgrub khang la nyi ma lhag gi shar gyi bar la ting nge 'dzin de'i ngang la 'byams te/ nyi ma shar 'phral 'jam skol ran par 'dug dgongs gzim phug gi phyir byon pas bsam gtan phu'i ri ra ba khang khyim thams cad za zi ban bun lang long du gyur nas snang ba thams cad bden med du rtogs pa snyam byed pa byung /

de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes brtags rung tsam du gda'/ gang zag phyi mar na 'phos par go gsungs shing / yang skabs der rmi lam gyi khrid kyi skabs su rje nyid kyis bsam gtan phur mnal lam bzung nas dgon pa ma'i bla brang na rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho bzhugs pa la mjal bar phebs pas/ bla brang gi sgo de mnan 'dug pas logs kyi dkar khung la 'dzegs pa'i tshul gyis nang du zhugs byon pas/ bla brang gi 'og gzhi me ma mur gyis khengs 'dug pa de rnams dkor rdzas su 'dug gsungs shing / de nas rje'i gzim chung dkar me khra thag ge 'dug pa'i nang du byon pas rje la byin rlabs zhus pas/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i phyag nas bdud rtsi ka pā la gang gnang byung ba gsol ba'i snang ba byung gsungs shing / nangs par ne gu'i chos thun zhu bar phebs pas tshogs 'khor la tshogs chang cung zad 'dug pas/ rje'i bzhes 'phro zhal dkar nas rje bla ma nyid la gnang ste/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ da res kyi ne gu'i khrid 'di gling dga' tshogs chen la bshad pa yin te/ chos rje shangs pa la bshad pa 'dra cig byung gsungs pas/ rje nyid kyi dgongs pa la mdang dgong rmi lam bzung nas yong skabs bdud rtsi gnang byung ba de de ring 'di 'ong ba'i rten 'brel du 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs so/ /yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi rin chen bzhi'i bsnyen pa la rtse gcig tu mdzad skabs lung bstan khyad par can byung ba'i tshul ni/ rje'i gsung las/ de'i skabs shig mnal lam du mi la ras pa yin zer ba zhig byung nas khyod lo 'di tsam gyi dus na 'chi/ zhes sku tshe ha cang mi ring pa'i lo grangs shig gi dus btab byung pas/ rje nyid kyis 'o na de nas gang du skye gsungs pas/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po zhig gi bur skye zer ba byung gsungs shing / de'i sku'i skye ba phyi ma ni rje btsun rin po che dang /

chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta sogs kyi rnam thar dang mtshungs pa'i mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i lung bstan thob par gdon mi za ba zhig yin mod kyang 'dir ma bris so/ /rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po de yang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig yin par sems so/ /rje 'di nyid phyis sku tshe ring ba'i tshad du gyur pa ni tshe sgrub zab mo rnams nyams su bzhes pa'i phan yon yin gsungs shing / 'khor lo bde mchog gi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa zhi rgyas dbang drag yod pa'i rgyas pa'i dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu byas pas kyang 'chi ltas 'ga' re shar rung de'i nyes pa las grol ba myong grub yin gsungs/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i tshul gong du bstan pa der ma zad/ gzhan yang bsam gtan phu'i bla brang du thugs dam la bzhugs skabs shig khro mo ba zhes pa spyir sdig pa tshabs can bsags kyang rje nyid la shin tu mos pa'i gang zag cig gling dga' dgon pa mar 'das skabs/ snga dro nyi ma shar dros shig gi tshe rje'i gzim khang gi sgo mdo phug gnyis ka 'byed mkhan med par rang phyer bye nas gzim khang gi nang thams cad sha rul gyi dri 'dra ba zhig gis khengs byung ba zhabs drung na yod pa kun gyi spyod yul du gyur mtshams/ rje'i phyag phyi ba rnams la drung du shog cig pa'i brda gnang byung 'phral phyin pas/ rje'i zhal nas snying re rje khro mo ba 'das 'dug lam ston gyi grabs gyis gsungs pa bzhin byas pas de ma thag thugs dam 'dogs 'bul mi sleb byung zhes bden pa'i ngag las thos shing / gang zag de dme kho na byas pa'i sdig can yin kyang 'dren pa dam pa 'di'i thugs rjes phyis 'brog sib na mi lus gcig long 'dug ces grags so/ /yang mus gnas gsar du spyan drangs nas stong dpon zhal ngo rnams kyi yum byang sems srid 'dren gshegs dus/ sle lung / ya ma rdzong rnams kyi dge 'dun sum brgya tsam gyi dbus su lam ston ngo sprod mdzad pas byang rten dngos su 'gul ba la grwa pa yon bdag kun ha las par gyur cing /

der skabs kyang byang sems de'i bar srid gzigs par grags shing / gzhan yang rje nyid kyis dbon po rin chen klu dbang la khyod nged rang gi nye ba zhig gi skye ba yin gsungs shing / dgon pa'i grwa rigs 'ga' zhig la grwa pa 'di dang 'di gang zag 'di zhes bya ba'i skye ba yin gsungs pa dang / zangs dkar sum mdo'i gnas po kha la so nyis rim skyes pa zhig yod pa la 'di tshogs bdag gi sprul pa yin las che gsungs shing / ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin kho rang gi ngo nas bzung grong pa de pa dar rgyas su gyur pa yin la/ dpal sa skyar bzhugs skabs kyang de 'dra ba mang du byung bar grags shing / gzhan yang bla ma yi dam chos skyong gur mgon/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ dam can mon bu pu tra sogs kyis zhal yang yang bstan pa'i tshul ni/ rje 'di dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis su phebs pa glang gi lo kho bo cag zhabs drung du sleb rgyu'i snga char/ dge slong byams pa dpal dang / rje dbon klu dbang / rje dbon sangs dar sogs drung na gnas pa rnams la rje'i gsung las/ de ring gza' skar bzang ngan ci yod kyang de la ltos pa med/ mdang nub bla brang 'dir nged rang sa skya zhabs drung dang mjal zhing / bzhin ras dang dbyibs tshul 'di ltar 'dug ces dngos su gzigs pa ltar sgra ji bzhin du gsungs pa ni kho bo cag rje nyid kyi 'od gsal gyi ngang nas gzigs par gdon mi za bar 'dug cing / lhag par bla brang gzim chung gi bla ma rabs rim gyi gzim mal 'di na gur gyi mgon po 'khor bcas yang sngar las gzi brjid bkrag mdangs che zhing na bza' sogs kyang zab pa byas byon 'dug ces gsungs shing dges dges du ma mdzad kyin 'dug ces thos la/ de ltar bkod ma thag pa'i gsung gi tshig rigs la dpags na de gong nas kyang bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du yang yang gzigs pa la the tshom mi dgos par snang zhing /

yang bsam gtan phur bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sku tshad shin tu che bas zil dang bcas gzim phug gi mdo der 'chams stabs du ma mdzad pa zhig kyang dngos su gzigs par grags shing / yang lan cig sku mdun na a tsa ra mang po bro byed kyin 'dug gsungs/ de gang lags zhus pas/ ne gu'i chos skyong rnams yin par 'dug gsungs shing / gzhan yang rje nyid dpal sa skyar phebs pa'i skabs der sgo rum nang so sogs bstan srung mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams mjal bar phebs pa'i tshe na'ang rtags ngo mtshar can du ma byung ba yin cing / lhag par kha'u brag rdzong du phebs nas nyi ma gsum gyi bar la mchod gtor rgya chen po mdzad pas/ de'i nyi ma dang po'i nyin gtor tshogs kyi steng gi nam mkha' la ral gri me 'bar ba zhig 'dug pa mngon sum du gzigs shing / nyi ma bar ma'i nyin 'phags pa brag phug na thugs dam la bzhugs dus bar snang la bram ze dkar po zhig phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa mngon sum du gzigs gsungs shing / chos skyong bram ze'i gzugs can nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa'i skabs der gzhan yang gzigs snang khyad par can du ma byung bar mngon la/ de ltar zhing skyong dregs pa'i gtso bo gdong bzhi mthu rtsal can 'di ni rje nyid la sa skya pa'i chos skyong gzhan rnams las kyang lhag par 'go ba yin te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bstan dgra bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gi rje'i thugs rgyud dkrugs tshe gsung shugs chen po dang bcas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dam nyams bstan dgra 'di zhes bya ba zhal du bzhes shig ces gsungs shing phyag phreng rdeb pa sogs mdzad pa na/ dmigs yul de la lo zla ma 'gyang par rtags 'byung ba myong bas grub cing yongs la grags pa yin la/ yang skabs 'gar rje nyid dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i slob bu 'ga' zhig 'das pa na yang dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa nga'i mi chung re re gnyis bdag gnyer yang mi yong ba zhes gsung shugs chen pos chos skyong nyid la bka' bskyon pa'i tshul du ma mdzad pa drung na gnas pa rnams las thos so/

/mdor na rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa 'di nyid bdag gi bla ma 'di mi dang mi lab pa'i tshul gyis bran bzhin du 'khol ba'i rnam par thar pa mang du yod kyang 'dir chos skyong gnyan pas 'bri bar ma nus so/ /gzhan yang chos skyong rnams kyi rnam sprul du mas zhal bstan cing lung bstan brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ rje nyid mus kyi rdzong dga' ldan rtser zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston du ma stsol zhing bstan pa dang sems can gyi don 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa'i ngang du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na/ tho rangs shig rje nyid kyi mnal lam du skras pa ring mo nam mkha'i mthong la ye re ba gcig la mi nag po 'jigs su rung ba gcig 'dzegs song nas/ rje nyid la nga'i rjes la shog zer byung ba la/ skras pa 'di la ma thar pa yong ngam snyam thugs bag tsha ba tsam 'dug pa la/ de ma thag ban chung dril chung g.yer kha mang po btags pa zhig byung nas skras pa de la yar rgyug mar rgyug mang du byas/ 'di tsam la mi thar ba yar song zer 'phul byung bas/ rje nyid kyis skras pa de la 'dzegs byon pas spras mgor sngar gyi mi nag po des phyag 'dren btang byung ba sogs rmis mtshams mnal sad byung ba na zhabs drung na gnas pa kun la nged la rmi lam 'di bzhin byung zhes snga bar gsungs pa'i phyi dro'i cha la babs pa tsam na/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nas sprul sku mgon po tshe dbang dpon g.yog rnams/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thugs dam dang bcas gsang sngags bde chen gling gi mkhan por rje nyid spyan 'dren la rdzong bar mdzad pa rnams 'byor byung pas/ rje'i gsung gis/ spyir dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong dang / chen po'i mchod gnas sogs blo la gtan nas med kyang / da lam ni phyin na legs pa 'dug ste mdang nub rmi lam du byung ba'i mi nag po de gur gyi mgon po yin tshod du 'dug la/

ban chung de zhal bzhi pa'i sprul par 'dug gsungs shing / 'di lta bu ni sa skya pa'i chos skyong gi gtso bo gnyis kyang rje nyid la gus 'dud kyi sgo nas spyan 'dren gyi pho nya byon par snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas yin zhing / gzhan yang snga gong zhig 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i drung du rje nyid dpal sa skyar gnas bskor phebs chog pa'i snyan 'bul zhus pas/ rje'i gsung gis da lta 'gro mi dgos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus zhar la 'khor ba zhig 'ong zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan yang yod pa yin la/ yang 'od gsal gyis nye ring med pa sgrib med du gzigs pa'i tshul ni/ spyir rje 'di la snga gong nas su 'od gsal gyi rgyun bzang po yod par snang ste/ sku gzhon nu'i dus su yang thugs gnyer la brtson par mdzad skabs 'od gsal ngo mtshar can shar ba'i lo rgyus gsungs pa dang / sa skyar phebs skabs dad ldan 'ga' zhig la/ nged la 'od gsal gyi rgyun cung zad yod kyang dkor ches pas 'grib 'gro yi 'dug ces gsungs 'dug cing / yang sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying mar gsung ngag gnang skabs nyin gcig chos nyan pa rnams 'dus mtshams rje nyid gsung shugs chen pos phyag rdeb pa dang / g.ya' g.ya' sgrub pa ma de zhes gsungs pas/ chos nyan pa rnams ci gsungs pa yin nam snyam pa la/ cung zad nas rje nyid la shin tu dad pa'i sgrub pa ma rgyal mtshan du byas pa de gdong khrag ral nyil le ba dang bcas byung pa na/ chos nyan rnams kyis ci yin dris pas/ chos ma zin dogs ltab rtob tu yong bas sa dkar logs su brdabs pa yin zer byung bas/ chos nyan pa kun na re/ sgrub pa ma brdabs pa rje'i 'od gsal gyis sgrib med du gzigs so zhes mgrin gcig tu sgrog cing thag chod pa yin la/ dus phyis bsam gtan phur thugs dam la bzhugs skabs gling dga' dgon pa mar rje dbon nam sangs dang / bsod nams mchog ldan zer ba'i grwa pa zhig 'thab rtsod cung zad byung ba la/

rje dbon gyis rje'i zhabs drung du phyin pas de ma thag khyod gnyis kyi da rang 'thab rtsod 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba byas ā/ zhes gsungs nas de'i tshig rigs rnams ma 'phyugs par gsungs byung bas/ rje dbon shin tu skrag nas gang yang zhu ma nus pa na/ da phyin btsun pa yin pas ngang blo bsring dgos zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa dang / yang dgon pa rdzong du bzhugs dus lam 'bras gnang skabs shig nyin cig yul shin tu ngan pa byung bas/ ja khang du gsol tshigs la phebs pa'i skabs shig dge slong sangs rgyam zer ba'i dgon pa'i grwa pa zhig gis phyag dbang zhu bar phyin nas phyag rten la mar gong zhig phul byin rlabs zhus pas/ mar phyag tu bzhes nas rje'i gsung las/ mar ril gsum 'dug pa la chung shos 'di khyer ba yin nam gsungs byung bas/ dge slong pa phyag 'bul zhing mar ril gsum yod lags/ 'di chung ba yin/ che ba gnyis kyang rting la 'bul bsam/ da lam chung ba phul ba lags/ thugs mkhyen gyis dgongs par 'dug zer dad pas mchi ma dbang med du btang zhing slar log ste mar ril gnyis po yang khyer byung bas/ rje'i zhal nas/ ngas mngon shes min/ chod btab pa mngon shes 'dra ba yong gsungs bzhad pa gnang gin 'dug ces kyang de dus kyi rgyus yod dag gi ngag las thos shing / yang gnas der dus re zhig gi tshe dgon par mi shin tu dben par byung ba'i skabs/ dbu mdzad shes rab legs pa zer ba'i grwa pa zhig gis ja 'debs gnyis btab/ sha zhig btsos nas ja 'debs gcig 'thung / sha btsos pa khyer te bla ye zhig yod par thul pa bting ste gcer bur nyal te ja 'thungs/ sha zos/ rang lus la thal lcag bsnun te/ ngag nas btsun pa shes rab legs pa khyod las skyid pa su yod zer ba sogs bag yangs kyi spyod pa de bzhin byas nas/ de mtshams ja rting ma khyer te rje'i drung du phyag rten mar gshags shig dang bcas byin rlabs zhu bar phyin pas/

rje bla brang gi yang steng na zhabs bskor gnang gi 'dug par byin rlabs zhus/ sku gzhogs su bsdad pas/ gsol ja mchod 'phro la dbu mdzad la spyan cher te gzigs nas/ dbu mdzad pa da res kyi spyod pa de 'dra ma byed gsungs/ dbu mdzad pas ci lags zhus pas/ da phyi khyed gcer bur 'dug pa dge slong rgan po zhig gis de ltar byas na dkon mchog thugs khrel 'gro/ gcig pur bsdad na lus la ltos/ /mang po'i khrod du sems la ltos/ /zer ba yin pas de 'dra ma byed gsungs byung bas/ dge slong gi bsam pa la rje'i gzigs pa'i sar de ltar byas pa ni ye med/ thugs mkhyen dang 'od gsal sgrib med du mnga' ba la the tshom mi 'dug snyam dge slong shin tu 'jigs nas smra mi shes pa lta bu byung zer ba de dus zhabs drung na yod pa'i brdzun mi zer ba dag gi ngag las thos so/ /kho bo cag la'ang rje'i gsung las/ nged kyis gling dga'i bla brang der snga mor langs nas thugs dam byas pa na/ dar tsam re nas nam ma langs kyang nang 'khor phal cher mthong ba'i 'od gsal skya hod de ba de 'dra 'char gyin bdog ces gsungs shing / yang rje chos grwa zur du bzhugs skabs ngos cag dpon slob rnams bla brang mar yod pa la/ bya ba spyod lam gang byas thams cad thogs med du mkhyen nas/ de dang mthun pa'i thugs dam dang slob gnyer byed lugs kyi bka' stsal bslab ston rim par byung ba mthun nang du grub pa yin zhing / gzhan yang bu slob 'ga' zhig zhabs drung du 'ong ba na nangs par 'ong ba'i do nub rje'i gsung las/ gang zag 'di 'dra zhes bya ba rta khal sogs 'di lta bu byas rang re'i rtsar 'ong gin 'dug ces 'od gsal gyi ngang nas sgrib med du mkhyen pa na gang bka' stsal pa bzhin thog tu 'bab pa dang / gzhan yang kho bo cag zhabs drung na yod skabs/ gang zag 'ga' zhig la 'od gsal yod pa'i gsung gleng byung dus rje'i gsung las/

'od gsal yod na dag pa'i zhing khams rnams la 'od gsal mched nas mthong na ngo mtshar chen po 'ong tshod du gda' zhes gsungs pa sogs gang nas bsams kyang bdag gi bla ma 'di la nyin mtshan gyi snang ba 'dre nus pa'i 'od gsal rgyun mi chad mnga' ba la the tshom cung zad kyang mi dgos pa yin no/ /gzhan yang gzhan sems shes pa dang ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa la sogs pa lkog gyur gyi don sgrib med du gzigs pa'i mngon par shes pa mtha' dag mnga' ba'i tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ ngam ring chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs pa'i skabs shig chos rgyal chen po blon 'bangs dang bcas pas nangs gcig rje 'di'i bstod pa sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma la/ 'ga' zhig bdag bstod yin no zhes dang / la la zhig gis gzhan gyis phul ba yin zhes rtsod pa chen po byung bas/ nangs par rje'i zhabs drung du chos thun la tshogs skabs 'phros rkyen gang yang med par rje'i gsung las/ bdag gi bstod pa 'di bdag rang la rje rin po che chos 'phel bas gnang ba lags gsungs byung bas/ mi dbang chen po blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dam pa 'di la thugs mkhyen thogs med du mnga' bar thag chod cing / gzhan yang 'di 'dra'i rigs mang du byung bar grags la/ yang skabs shig chos rgyal chen po'i yum gyi nang rten la phyag nas mdzad par spyan 'dren mi yong tsam gyi gong du gling dga' dgon pa'i grwa pa rags bsdus phyag g.yog 'ga' dang bcas pa la rje'i gsung gis/ rang re rnams deng sang rab gnas kyi yig cha rnams la ltos shig gsungs byung ba la kun gyis gzigs grub mtshams ngam ring nas dpon slob rags bsdus phyag nas la phebs dgos gsungs pa'i spyan 'dren pa byung bas/ snga gong de bzhin dgos pa'i snyan 'bul ma byung bas kun gyi mngon mkhyen yin pa thag chod cing / yang gser mdog dbon po bsod nams rtse mo dpon slob rnams rje'i zhabs drung du gsung ngag zhu ba la sleb skabs/

rje'i gsung gis/ khyed rnams la 'tshub cha chen po 'dug pas/ yang na tshe la bar chad byung dogs 'dug yang na nor god chen po cig yong ba 'dra gsungs shing cung zad thugs 'tshab pa'i rnam pa mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ phyis khams su gser mdog pa dpon slob rnams dgra jag dang thug nas srog thar pa la rab byed dgos pa byung zhes thos shing / yang khams kyi chos rje dgra lha ba la yang zhal gyi rjes gnang gnang dus rten 'brel gyi sgo dang mthun pa'i lung bstan gnang ba de kho nar thog tu babs so zhes kyang thos la/ yang sa skya nas chos mdzad nor bu bsam 'phel dang / sku gnyer kun dga' bde legs gnyis kyis rje nyid gling dgar bzhugs pa'i zhabs drung du phyin nas slar log 'ong khar rje'i gsung las/ deng sang dbyar dus yin pas chu shin tu che bas khyed rang gnyis mdog chu la zangs dkar gyi ko ba la ma 'gro bar/ nges par se mkhar chung gi lcags la rgyugs zhes yang yang gsungs byung bas khong gnyis kyis rim pas chu khar sleb pa dang / mi mang po ko ba la 'gro grabs byed pa dang thug byung bas/ thog mar de rnams dang ldan cig tu 'gro grabasabyas/ de 'phral rje'i gsung dran nas lcags bskor du phyin pas/ khong rang gnyis kyi mthong sa der sngar gyi ko ba de rdibs nas mi nor thams cad chus khyer song bas/ khong gnyis rje'i gsung la yid ches shing mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ces thos la/ yang rje 'dis nyid rdzong gi gdan sar bzhugs skabs sde pa gdong dga' ba'i bla ma mdzad dgos pa'i snyan 'bul dang spyan 'dren yang yang byung ba na/ rje 'di'i zhal bzhes gtan nas gnang ma 'dod pa la phyag phyi ba rnams da lam zhal bzhes gnang na snyam pa tsam byung zhes thos la/ de'i phyi lo gdong dga' ba'i zhal ngo la 'das grong byung ba gsan pa'i tshe phyag phyi ba rnams la rje'i gsung gis/ na ning 'u rang tshos phyin na da lo kha skyengs po mi yong ba 'dug gam zhes gsungs pas/

phyag phyi ba rnams kyis shin tu mad lags zhes zhus shing / khong rnams mgrin gcig par rje la thugs mkhyen yod nges shes so zhes sgrog par byed do/ /yang rje 'di nyid ngam ring nas rgyas sder phebs pa'i drung du bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dpon slob rnams rab byung zhu bar gsang stabs su phebs pa'i nub bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ma chen shin tu na bar byung ba/ nangs par rje 'di la zhu mkhan med par thogs med du mkhyen nas ma chen la khams bde 'dri bar mdzad byung zhes 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyi gsung las thos so/ /yang chos rje ka spe bas khong rang gis snga gong byas 'gyur du mtshams rgyun ring du byas skabs rmi lam ya mtshan can 'ga' zhig byung ba legs nyes kyi lung bstan rje nyid la zhus pas/ khyed kyi rmi lam byung ba'i go rim rnams nor song / khyod kyi rmi lam 'di'i rjes su 'di byung 'dug pa zhes go rim rnams ma 'khrug pa gsungs shing legs nyes kyi lung bstan gnang byung bas/ chos rje ka spe ba nyid shin tu ha las par gyur ro zhes khong rang las dngos su thos shing / yang gling dga' chos grwa zur du bdag sogs dad ldan gyi 'gro ba mang po la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos rgya mtsho lta bu bka' drin stsal ba'i skabs 'khor lo bde mchog gi khrid gnang ba'i dus su nyin gcig gi tshe chos yun thung ba zhig mdzad nas/ rje nyid zhal 'dzum mdzad de/ chos zhu'i dkyil na gser mdog dbon po zhig yod pa la spyan cher gzigs nas de ring gser mdog dbon po ni khams la 'gro ba'i grabs kho na byed kyin 'dug gsungs byung bas/ bdag rnams ni de dus ci gsungs pa yin nam snyam pa las ma byung / der rjes chos grwa'i phyir sleb 'phral gser mdog dbon po rang dang 'phros byung pas/ khong rang na re/ de ring nged la khams la 'gro ba'i rnam rtog kho na 'gyu nas dmigs khrid gang yang ma shes pas de rje rin po che'i mkhyen par 'dug ces zer byung bas thams cad 'jigs shing ha las par gyur to/

/yang 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang gnang skabs/ de'i phyag len la maṇḍal la rdul tshon dkar pos 'khor lo dang / yi ge 'bri ba gcig dang / padma 'dab brgyad 'dri ba'i lugs gnyis 'dug pas 'di gnyis gang dag gi dogs gcod zhu ba'i rtog pa bdag gi blo la shar 'phral rje nyid kyi gsung 'phro gzhan zhig bcad nas bdag la spyan cher gzigs te 'di'i phyag len 'di la rje spyan snga ba yang 'di bzhin mdzad cing / padma 'dab brgyad 'dri ba 'di dag go zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsungs byung pas shin tu dad cing bdag kyang 'di'i phyag len 'di la dogs gcod cig zhu dgos snyam pa yod pa la/ zhu ma dgos pa gnang ba bka' drin che zhus shing / sems la bla ma sangs rgyas 'di lta bu dang mjal ba re dga' snyam pa byung la 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang du yod mod/ 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /gzhan yang sa skya pa'i chos skyong mthu rtsal can rnams bka' las mi 'da' bar bran bzhin du 'khol ba'i tshul ni/ rje nyid gling dga' bde ba can gyi gdan sar phebs nas ha cang yun mi ring ba zhig na zab don ne gu chos drug gi khrid gnang ba'i tshe/ de'i tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad la dgos pa'i sha sogs spus dkon pa tsam byung ba la/ skabs der 'brog gzhon zhig gis sha stobs che ba rje nyid la phul bas shin tu dges shing khrid zhu ba rnams la'ang tshogs 'khor rgya chen po mdzad ces thos la/ de nas 'brog pa de log phyin pa'i lam du ru tsho mi gcig pa'i ngan pa 'ga' zhig gis bcom nas slar 'brog pa de rje'i zhabs drung du log byung nas smre sngags du ma zhu yin 'dug pa la/ rje nyid thugs khros te gsung shugs chen pos chos skyong rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing / nga'i yon bdag 'di la gang min byed mkhan de tsho la rtags dang mtshan ma da lta nyid du ston cig ces gsungs shing phyag phreng rdeb pa mdzad byung bas zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyang 'jigs shing skrag nas skad mi 'thon pa tsam byung zhes thos la/

de nas yun ring ma lon par sngar gyi chom po rnams gnas pa'i thod kyi brag don med du zhig nas phyugs ma rnams 'ur zhing sbra 'gyel ba dang chom po byed mi la brag chen po zhig phog ste rtags mtshan drag po mngon sum du byung zhes grags la/ yang gling dgar mus stong dpon dang dbon po kun dga' lhun grub sogs mched grogs 'ga' zhig la dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong gi man ngag phyi khrid srung 'khor brag rdzong ma zhal shes dang bcas pa gnang dus/ ljang lung la sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog gnang pas bran bdud pho mo'i gtor chog gi thad du sleb pa dang rlung 'tshub chen po zhig langs te bla brang yom yom byed pa tsam byung pas/ rje 'di nyid lta stangs kyis ngang la cung zad kyang mi g.yo bar bzhugs 'dug pas/ de ma thag rlung zhi song ba dang / rje 'di nyid kyi rlung drag po gsum 'bud pa gnang rjes/ rje'i gsung las/ bran bdud 'di la rjes gnang zhig dgos pas/ de ma byas par 'di'i lung byas pas kho ma dga' zer ba yin pa 'dug gsungs byung bas/ mus stong dpon sogs sku gzhogs na yod pa thams cad la mthun par lus zi bun byed pa byung zhes khong rang rnams las dngos su thos pas/ 'di ni las kyi gshin rje nag po yab yum gyi gdug rtsub kyi cho 'phrul rje 'di'i ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan nas bran du bkol ba la the tshom mi dgos par mngon zhing / yang skabs shig gling dga' bla brang du rje dpon slob rnams mi bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na ngan pa zhig gis rkun ma tshabs chen byas pa la/ rje 'di shin tu thugs khros pa'i tshul gyis chos skyong mthu rtsal can rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing rkun ma ngan pa de da lta nyid du rtsad chod cig ces gsung shugs chen pos gsungs shing phyag rdeb pa sogs mdzad byung pa na/ de mtshams bla brang gi tshoms kyi mthong khar bya rog cig babs byung pa la khyod kyang chos skyong gi sprul pa zhig yin yong /

rkun ma ngan pa'i rjes la rgyugs shig zhes gsung gin 'dug ces thos la/ de 'phral rje dbon sogs zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyis rta bzang po dang bcas phyogs bzhir kha bkram nas btsal bas rkun ma de rta mo shar gyi grog phug tu slebs pa na/ kho rang gi bsam pa la da nga do nub mtshan 'gros byas thag ring po zhig tu sleb pa 'gro snyam pa'i tshe/ glo bur du bya rog cig byung nas phyogs gang la phyin kyang gshog lcag kho na brgyab byung pas/ 'dir sdod zer ba yin nam snyam bsdad pas nam langs mtshams rje dbon rnams der slebs nas dngos po thams cad gyar med du phyag tu 'byor 'dug pa 'di lta bu'i mthu rtsal ni sngon gyi rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras gong ma rnams dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras sogs skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig la byung bar grags kyi/ gzhan tshe gang drag sngags kho na 'dren pa la nan tan du byas pa'i mthu rtsal chen por rlom zhing dregs pa phal cher la 'di lta bu byung ba mthong ba'am thos pa med do/ /yang snga gong gi dus shig rje nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bka' bzhin thub bstan du rje byams pa rab brtan pa'i drung du mgon po'i chos skor rnams gsan par phebs dus bar lam kun la chos skyong gi sprul pa bya nag gnyis kyis bskyel bsu kho na byed pa yang byung zhes thos la/ yang dus der chom po 'ga' zhig gis rje dpon slob rnams bsgug dod byas pa mkhyen nas/ rje 'dis chos skyong la gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol mdzad nas byon pas chom po rnams grog gting du bza' btung bya ba'i bar la rje dpon slob rnams nyes med du phebs pas/ phyis rje'i gsung gis/ nged la'ang gtor 'bul tsam byas pas chom po'i 'jigs pa las dngos su bskyabs pa sogs chos skyong 'di rnams byin rlabs dang mthu rtsal gzhan las mchog tu che ba yin no/ /zhes bstod bkur bsngags gsum du ma mdzad pa yin la/

gzhan yang bsam gtan phur bzhugs pa'i dus shig chos skyong gi sprul pa a tsa ra'i cha lugs can 'ga' zhig bro byed pa mngon sum du gzigs nas rje nyid kyang thugs nyams 'ur te de rnams dang lhan cig tu bro mdzad nas slar gzim phug tu byon te/ da res kyi chos skyong gi sprul pa de rnams a 'dug gzigs pas/ de nas kyang gzim phug gi 'gag de kha na 'dug ces gsungs shing / de rnams ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sprul pa'i 'khor du 'dug gsungs la/ yang gsung las/ nged la lung bstan pa phal cher ye shes kyi mgon po 'dis byed kyin 'dug ces kyang dad ldan gyi bu slob 'ga' zhig la gsungs pa las brgyud de thos so/ /tshul 'di ni rje bla ma 'di zab lam ne gu chos drug gi yang nyams rtogs kyi mnga' bdag chen por bzhugs pas na de'i chos skyong gis 'phrin las bsgrubs pa'i mtshan mar snang la/ gzhan yang dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi man ngag thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i dmar po skor gsum gyi nang tshan tshogs kyi bdag po yang rje nyid la zhal dngos su gzigs shing 'phrin las du ma bsgrubs pa'i lo rgyus yod la/ nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyis kyang bka' las mi 'da' bar rje nyid la gang dgos pa'i mthun rkyen rnams bsgrub par snang ste/ rje'i gsung las/ dbyug gu ma'i man ngag 'di shin tu zab pa yin/ nged grwa rkyang gi dus sgrub pa la yod skabs/ nyin cig mtshams g.yog pa de la khyod gang 'dod kyin 'dug dris pas/ bdag sha mar bzang po 'dra byung na bsam gda' lags zer byung pas/ de'i nub mo nged kyi dbyug gu ma'i sngags bzhi brgya tsam bgrang skabs nangs par nged la sha mar ster mi zhig khug shog zer ba byas pas/ de'i sang der glo bur du sha mar stobs che ba ster mi byung zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang nor sbyin dzambha la dmar pos kyang rje nyid kyi gsol ja'i zhabs tog bsgrub pa'i dad ldan gyi slob bu bkug pa'i tshul gyi lo rgyus ngo mtshar ba yang yod la/

phyis bsam gtan phur rje nyid kyi gsung las/ dus phyis dzam dmar dang dbyug gu ma sogs la gso ma sod pa las mi 'dug snyam nan tan cher ma byas zhes gsungs shing / mdor na rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i lhag pa'i lha khyad par can rnams kyis rje nyid la 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrubs pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa dang ldan pa yin la/ gzhan yang bka' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gcod kyi zab khrid kyi sgo nas gzhi bdag gdug pa can dam la btags shing / stobs ldan gyi 'byung po gnas spar ba dang gzugs med rnams kyis phyag dang bsu ba dang mchod pa'i yul dam par gyur pa kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa ni/ de yang rje nyid dga' ldan rtse'i gdan sa la phebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul la mus gnas gsar gyi mi dbang dpon blon rnams kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i tshe zhal gyis bzhes nas/ spyir rdzong gi gzhi bdag 'di shin tu 'tshub cing / lhag par gdan sa pa rim pa mang pos dbang khrid sogs chos tshan che ba 'chad pa mang po la chos de mthar phyin pa'i bar chad yang yang yong ba zhig yod 'dug pa la dgongs nas/ rje 'dis nangs par rdzong du phebs pa'i do nub sa 'dul gyi dmigs pa zhig mdzad pas mnal lam du ban gzugs ma rung ba 'ga' byung nas/ de rnams kyis rje'i bzhugs khri bar snang du bteg ste bskor ba sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs byas byung gsungs shing / de nas rdzong du phebs ste thog mar gcod khrid 'dzugs par mdzad pas/ khrid tshugs nas zhag kha yar song ba'i nub cig mtshan gung gi cha la dgon pa rdzong gi nye skor gyi lung pa thams cad ngu 'bod kyi sgra chen po lhang lhang gis khengs pa dgon par bzhugs pa'i grwa pa rnams dang nye skor gyi skye bo kun gyis thos pas/ nangs par rje nyid kyi drung du mdang nub de bzhin byung ba gang legs zhus pas/

rnal 'byor pa'i gzi brjid gdug 'dre tshos ma bzod tshod du gda' zhes gsungs shing / de nas gnas der gsung ngag lam 'bras gnang bar mdzad pas/ de'i snang gsum gyi khrid ma grol ba'i bar du gzhi bdag de'ang chos zhu ba la byung gsungs shing / sngags lam tshugs nas mi yong ba de srung 'khor bsgoms pas yin pa 'dra gsungs/ de phyin chad rdzong gi gdan sa pa thams cad la chos gang 'chad kyang bar chad mi 'byung ba'i mthar phyin pa ni rje 'di'i byin rlabs dang thugs rje rmad du byung ba'i bka' drin las byung ba kun la grags pa yin zhing / yang sa skyar phebs skabs lha khang bla brang du kyai rdor sgrub mchod cig gi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad pa'i tshe/ lha khang chen mo'i zur spe rig 'dzin pho brang du rje 'di'i bzhugs yul gnang bas sa phyogs de gnas rengs kyi rnam pas shin tu 'tshub pa zhig 'dug pa la/ ma gcig gi sbyin gtong dkar 'gyed cig mdzad pas nangs par de nas 'jam nyal gyis song zhes gsungs shing / stobs ldan gyi 'byung po gnas spar ba'i tshul ni/ rje 'dis gdan sa chen por phebs dus bde chen gling gi bla brang du bzhugs skabs/ nub cig mnal lam du nam mkha'i mthong na khra zhig gshog 'gyur ling 'dug pas/ rje rang gi dbu thog tu rgyag pa 'dra dgongs pa la/ de 'phral gzhung de brgyab byung bas/ rje nyid kyis yi dam gyi nga rgyal bzung pas khra de yal song zhing / mnal sad pa dang rje nyid kyi thugs la 'di na sngar gyi gdan sa pa rnying pa rnams la yang bar chad byed pa'i 'dre zhig yod 'dug kyang / rje rang la glags mi rnyed pa 'dug snyam pa 'khrungs shing / de nas ha cang mi ring ba zhig nas bdag la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs grags pa'i mtshan can nyid kyi sku 'khor ma chen zhig la rkang pa na bas rkyen byas/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum sus kyang 'dul bar ma nus pa'i jo bo shar par grags pa'i stobs ldan gyi 'byung po des gnod pas shin tu na ba dos drag po byung ba la/

bla ma lha rje gang gi yang byin rlabs dang bcos kas ma phan pa la/ sngags 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung gis/ rje mus chen nyid la tshe dbang zhig zhus na legs gsungs pa'i bka' phebs nas/ khong ma bu gnyis rje nyid kyi drung du byung bas/ rje 'dis khong ma bu la tshe dbang zhig mdzad pas/ gdon gyi skyon yin pa mkhyen nas bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs shig mdzad pas/ kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma zhes mtshan brjod pas/ ma chen nad pa de dran med du brgyal nas 'gyel song bas/ ma des shi song zer nas ngu yi 'dug pa la rje 'dis yon chab kyi chu zhig gdong la stor ba mdzad pas kho langs byung nas mchi ma gtong zhing / nga mgo na nas ding sang bar dran pas ma zin 'dug da lta gang byas pa yin zer nas smre sngags du ma 'don zhing 'dug go zhes kun la grags so/ /skabs der rje 'dis phyag mdud cig gnang nas da nad kyis gcig kyang skyon pa mi yong zhes lung bstan gnang bas de bzhin du nad las grol ba kun gyi mngon sum du gyur cing / de nas rje 'dis lan cig mus su phebs nas slar gdan sar phebs skabs sngar nas rje nyid la shin tu mos pa'i gdan sa chen po'i chos las pa chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal du grags pa de der skabs kyang rje 'di la yang yang mjal du byung ba la/ chos rje khong sngar bas sku mdangs dang gsung dpang dma' ba sogs 'o brgyal nyams che ba zhig 'dug pa la/ rje 'di'i gsung gis chos rje las chen pa khyed da lam sngar las sku mdangs sogs lod pa 'dug pa snyung ba sogs ma byung ngam gsungs pas/ chos rje khong shin tu ngo nong pa'i rnam pas bdag na ba bzhin ma byung na'ang / bdag tsho la mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i pho lha zhig yod pa na ning bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ma chen la rje rin po che'i byin rlabs gnang bas/ skabs der ma chen dran med du brgyal 'dug pa de dus bdag tsho'i lha de tshe 'phos nas bdag tsho'i nye 'brel rnams dang gdul bya'i rgyun sogs cung lod du song ba yin lags zhes zhus song ngo /

/zhes rje'i zhabs drung du yun ring bsdad pa rdzun mi zer ba dag gi ngag las thos so/ /de ltar rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug 'dis gnas spor ma mdzad pa'i sngon du jo bo shar par grags pa'i 'byung po 'di gdug rtsub shin tu che bas gdan sa chen po'i skye bo drag zhan phal cher gyis sku rten 'dzugs pa dang / mchod 'phrin sogs la 'bad dgos pa zhig yin na'ang / deng sang ming tsam yang mi grags pa 'di ni shin tu yid ches shing ngo mtshar ba'i gnas rmad du byung ba yin no/ /chos las pa der 'byung po 'dis mthun rkyen bsgrubs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni chos rje de'i yab ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin pa la/ lan cig sa skya'i phu'i ri ldebs shig la phyin pas/ mtshan mo'i ring la me 'od khrom khrom yong ba zhig 'dug pa ci yin nam bsam pa la/ nyin zhig de phyogs phyin pas sngar mthong ma myong ba'i btsun pa zhig dang 'phrad byung ba/ khyed su yin dris pas nged jo jo shar pa zer ba zhig yin/ nged rgyal rtse'i sku gnyer yon tan can zhig yin pa la/ nged la gzhan gyis phra ma bcug ste sde srid kyi btsun mo dang gtam cha zhig byung bas/ gong nas bka' bskyon phog pas/ nged kyis rgyal rtse pa'i sde pa rnams la smon lam log pa btab pas rkyen byas 'drer skyes te jo bo shar par grags la/ de nas rgyal rtse pa'i sde pa'i gdung rabs rnams bcad rjes sa skyar 'phos nas yongs pa yin pas da rang re gnyis kha dan byed pas nged la 'dir sdod gnas shig bzos rten gsol gyis shig khyod kyi mi brgyud la ngas phan chen po yong zer yal song bas/ chos rje las chen pas yab khong gi de bzhin byas pas khong rang mi brgyud mi nor dang bcas pa la phan thogs chen po byung bar grags so/ /dus phyis rje'i gsung gis ngas bsam pa la gdan sa chen por nad pa ma bu la byin rlabs byas dus nad pa de dran med la brgyal dus der sa skya pa'i chos skyong rnams kyi mthu rtsal dang byin rlabs la brten 'dre de tshe'i dus byas 'dug pa snying re rje bsam smon lam gang yong rang byas zhes gsungs so/

/'di lta bu'i rnam thar la so skye dag yid gnyis skye bar srid kyang de ltar dgos pa ma yin te/ de yang bsam yas chos skyong chen po sogs ngo bo sar gnas yin kyang / rnam pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshul bzung ba rnams ma gtogs/ gzhan smon lam log pa pa sogs kyi mtshams sbyor las byung ba'i 'byung po rnams ni stobs ji ltar che yang rang rang gi 'phen byed rdzogs byed kyi las ji tsam yod pa de rdzogs pa dang / rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs kyi byin rlabs la brten tshe 'phos te mtho ris kyi lus rten sogs su skye ba chos nyid yin pas/ des na jo jo shar par grags pa de yang rje 'di'i byin rlabs dang las 'brel smon lam gyi dbang zhig gis skabs der tshe 'phos par sems la/ ci ste de skabs kyi 'byung po de dngos ma yin yang / de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i gdug pa can 'jig rten ma rung par byed pa'i stobs ldan gyi 'byung po zhig yin pa gdon mi za bas gang ltar shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su shes par bya ba yin no/ /gzhan yang gzugs med rnams kyi phyag dang bsu ba dang mchod pa'i yul du gyur pa'i tshul ni/ gling dga'i nub rong chu tshan gyi gzhi bdag ma de sngon rje sems dpa' chen po bzhugs dus chab la phebs skabs sbrul chen po zhig tu sprul nas yang yang phebs bsu la yong gin yod pa la/ rje sems dpa' chen pos phyag brkyangs pa na sbrul de 'khril nas chab thogs su nam phebs dges dges mdzad nas bsnams pa zhig yod pas/ lan cig sbrul gyi mjug ma chibs pa'i rmig 'og tu shor nas bcad pa na/ de phyin chad gzhi bdag ma de sbrul mjug sdum ma zhig tu sprul nas phebs bsu la 'ong ngo zhes grags pa bzhin bdag gi bla ma 'di la'ang nub rong gi chab la phebs re bzhin du chab nas mda' rgyang re tsam gyi bar du sbrul mjug sdum pa de rgyun du phebs bsu la 'ong ba zhabs drung na gnas pa kun gyis snyon med du mthong ba yin zhing /

sbrul de byung dang bstun rje'i gsung las yang gzhi bdag ma de bsu ma la byung ngo zhes kyang gsung ba thos la/ de ltar gong du bstan pa ltar bdag gi bla ma mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mnga' bdag 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan gyi cha shas rags pa tsam yang bskal pa'i bar du'ang rang re so so skye bo dag gis ma lus pa brjod par nus pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang sems mthong lam thob pa zhig la'ang yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis dang ldan par gsungs na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po nyid kyi rnam par sprul par yang dag pa'i nges pa'i shes pa dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ de yang rje bla ma 'di nyid ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa nyid yin par yid gnyis dang bral ba yin la/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs buddha ratna shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas ni sa bcu'i byang sems nyid yin par tshad ldan gyi skyes bu la 'jig rten dbang phyug gis lung bstan par grags pa yin te/ de'ang kho bo cag lo gzhon nu'i dus grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar 'ga' zhig mthong bas rkyen byas/ nam 'chi cha med kyi tshe thung 'di la tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa gcig bya snyam pa dang / yang na 'chad nyan dang thugs dam spel mar byas te mi tshe stong zad du ma song ba zhig cis kyang bya snyam pa dang / de gnyis gang byed kyang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dang ma mjal ba'i thabs mi 'dug snyam pa sogs chos kyi snang ba mi chung tsam yod cing / lhag par rje btsun bslu med dam pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam thos pa'i mod la snying nas mjal 'dod kyi 'dod 'dun kha zhe med par dung dung pa yang yang du skyes shing / rje 'di la chos thob pa dang / sku drung nas 'ong ba yin zer ba'i grwa pa 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad pa na yang khyed rnams re dga'/ bla ma sangs rgyas de lta bu dang mjal 'dug snyam pa dang /

lhag par 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug rje 'di'i zhabs drung du rab byung dang / dbang rjes gnang mang po zhus nas phebs byung skabs/ rje 'di'i rnam thar 'dra gsungs byung pas/ bdag kyang rje dang mjal nas chos thob pa zhig byung na dga' ba la zhus shing / snying nas kyang mjal 'dod lhang lhang je 'phel du song ba zhig byung la/ yang rje nyid ngam ring du phebs skabs shig sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang gnang grub 'phral der rtsa brgyad pa drung 'tsho lha 'byor gdan sa chen por 'byor byung ba'i lag par dpung skud cig 'dug pa la/ khyed kyis nye stabs dbang su la zhus smras pas/ rje mus chen la sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang thob pa yin zer zhing / rje'i rnam thar 'ga' zhig gi 'phros byung bas nged kyang bla ma sangs rgyas de dang mjal nas chos thob pa'i dus shig e yong na zhes pa kha nas yang shor zhing yid la yang de bzhin byung ba yin la/ de nas skabs shig bdag la bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i ma cig lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo de nyid ngam ring du mi dbang chen por mjal ba la phebs pa'i sgo dod pa na/ der skabs rje mus chen nyid kyang ngam ring na bzhugs so zhes thos pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la da lta gangs can gyi khrod na dge ba'i bshes gnyen thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur cing / lhag par dad ldan gyi slob bu la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol zhing / mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med du mnga' ba'i skyes bu rje mus chen kho na las gzhan med do zhes dpyod ldan gzur gnas mang po'i ngag las thos shing / rang yang snying nas yid ches thob pa la brten da ni kho bo cag 'di phyi bar do gsum gyi skyabs gnas dang 'dren pa zhu ba'i blo rtse'i gtad mtshams kyi yul sngar gyi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched zhal rnam gnyis dang /

rje bla ma 'di kho na las gzhan med par rtogs nas bka' drin can gyi ma cig lha sras rgyal mo brgyud pa'i rje 'di la bdag gis zhu yig phul ba'i don 'bras la/ bdag tshe ha cang mi ring ba zhig byung na thos bsam rgya cher byas pa la don mi 'dug pas tshe ring thung 'ong dang / thog ma mdo sngags gang la sbyangs na legs dang / dbu zhwa sogs sku dreg phog nges pa'i na bza' zhig byin rlabs rten du gnang ba dang / sems la phan pa'i gsung mgur bslab ston zhig gnang dgos zhus pas/ de'i lan du thugs dam gsung shog 'di bzhin gnang byung ste/ 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku gsung thugs rab tu dwangs shing dkar phyogs dge ba la mngon par brtson pa'i skabs nas thugs dam bka' shog dam rdzas kyi gnang sbyin dang bcas spyi bor phebs pas bka' drin che lags/ sku phywa btab pas sku tshe ring po yongs pa gda'/ thugs sbyong snga ma gang mdzad pa dga' btab pas mdo mdzad pa dga' ba gda'/ thugs sbyong gnang gong mi g.yo ba dkar po'i bsnyen pa gcig mdzad na legs pa gda' legs/ thugs dam slob gnyer la sogs pa gang mdzad na'ang thugs rtse dkon mchog la gtad nges 'byung drag po'i sgo nas rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pas mdzad dgos te/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ mdor na chos kyis ci byed bsam/ /sangs rgyas byed na chos bzhin gyis/ /zhes gsungs/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos/ nyams su len pa'i chos la/ /blo snying brang gsum gtad nas/ /sems snang chos su sres shig /'di phyi bar do gsum du/ /'di yis bslu ba med pas/ /ma nor lam la 'bungs shig /ces gsungs pa sogs mang dag gda' na'ang yi ge mang dogs ma bris lags/ mdor na snga mus ltar thugs dam thugs sbyong res med bstan pa la dgongs nas mkhyen mkhyen/

zhu yig gzigs rten tshe mdud la rgya mdzes phul/ zhwa mo sogs bdag gi dri phog pas 'bul ma nus zhes gsungs pa 'dug pa mthong ba'i mod la/ rje de nyid la mjal 'dod dang chos thob 'dod kyi blo me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa ltar je 'phel du gyur pa zhig byung la/ gsung shog der mi g.yo ba dkar po'i bsnyen pa byed dgos par 'dug tshul gsungs pa de ni sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis slob ma 'ga' zhig la rten 'brel sgrig par mdzad pa'i tshe yang mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang sogs gnang 'dug pa dang mtshungs par kho bo cag la'ang phyis su rje btsun bslu med gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho lta bus shes rgyud gtams shing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres nas skye ba gtan legs kyi mdun ma zin pa'i rten 'brel gyi thog ma de dus sgrig par mdzad pa la the tshom cung zad kyang dgos pa ma yin no/ /de nas dus ha cang mi ring ba zhig lon pa glang lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub bka' drin 'khor mtha' med pa'i lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo de nyid glo bur zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa la brten nas yid la bzod thabs med pa'i zug rngu drag pos kun tu gzir zhing / gang la'ang snying po med par rtogs pa'i nges 'byung drag pos tshe 'di blos btang gi sgrub pa zhig byed 'dod nas/ snga gong zhig grags pa'i mtha' can gyis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun gyi sku dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i sku 'dra mdze thod ma'i drung du mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas gsol ba btab nas lung bstan zhus pa la 'brel tshad don ldan gyis bla ma rje mus chen de nyid dang mjal ba zhig yongs mi yongs dang / tshe 'di blos btang gi sgrub pa zhig byas na bar snang la 'phur nus pa'i grub thob cig yong mi yong dang / yang tshe 'dir bshad sgrub spel mar byas na bar dor 'bras bu 'grub pa zhig yong mi yong rnams lung bstan zhus pas/

lung bstan mi bzang ba ma byung zhing / de mthun gyi ma cig lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan ma thag pa'i skabs der rje nyid kyi drung du lam ston gyi chas rnams 'bul ba dang bcas zhu yig phul ba'i don 'bras la/ sngar rje btsun gyi sku'i drung du lung bstan zhus pa'i rnam grangs rnams dang / lhag par bka' drin can gyi yum de gang du 'khrungs yod rnams la lung bstan gsal kha can zhig dgos tshul zhus pa na/ de'i lan du thugs dam gsung shog 'di bzhin gnang byung ste/ 'jam dbyangs rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon par mtho zhing thos bsam sgom gsum la thugs brtson par bzhugs skabs nas gsung shog gos gser ma dang bcas gnang ba thugs la btags/ yum rin po che cho 'phrul gyi tshes bco lnga la sku tshe'i tshad rdzogs pa ltar mdzad nas gshegs pa de bya ba khams chen byung 'dug lags kyang / 'di ltar skyes pa thams cad kyis/ /mdun na gnas pa 'chi ba yin/ /zhes dang / mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pa yi/ /rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po med 'dra ba'i/ /chu bur lus la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa gda' ba/ yin lugs kyang kun rdzob tu chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu dang / don dam par spros bral yin par thugs la bzhugs par zhu lags/ lung bstan byed pa la sa dang po chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong dgos mod/ bdag lta bu de'i phyed dang po tsam gyi yon tan gang yang med pas lung bstan ga la yong lags/ yum de mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags tshang ba dang / grong rkyen dang grong dus zhal ngo rnams kyi byin rlabs la brten gnas mthon por 'khrungs pa gzhir bcas su 'dug lags/ zhabs drung rin po che rang la bshad sgrub gnyis ka la mo bzang ba rang 'dug lags/ rang re zhal mjal ba zhig yong zer ba babs lags/

da phyin thugs dam dang thugs gnyer spel mar gnang mdzod lags/ nyams len gang mdzad dang bya ba gang mdzad thams cad dkon mchog gsum la mgo bcad pang skyur gyi tshul du thog khel gyi rtse gcig tu thugs gtod par zhu lags/ slar sku tshe ring zhing bkra shis la thugs bsam chos bzhin du 'grub par smon lags/ sku rim srung 'khor yang cher gtad bsgrubs pas/ bde kye yo ga gsum gyi rgyud man ngag gzhung phran dang bcas pa rnams la gzigs rtog phul phyin rang sa ngor gnyis kyi bstan pa thugs la bzhag pa mkhyen mkhyen/ cis kyang dgos gsungs pa nas zhu yig spyan zur g.yo rten bo dhi tsitta'i phreng ba la rgya mdzes phul zhes gsungs pa 'dug pa mthong bas sems dga' ba dang spro ba tshad las 'das pa rab dga'i sa thob pa ltar gyur cing / de ltar bka' drin can gyi ma cig lha sras de nyid zhing gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas ha cang mi ring ba zhig 'das pa'i tho rangs kyi cha zhig na/ bdag gi rmi lam du yum bka' drin can de nyid gsal bar byon byung pa la/ zhing brjes pa'i snang ba ma 'gags bzhin du bdag gis deng sang a ma lags mngal sgo mi rnyed pa'i 'o brgyal chen po mi 'dug lags sam zhes sogs zhus pas/ ma'i gsung las de tsam gyi sdug bsngal rang mi 'dug cing / lhag par nged la 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi lung bstan byung nas/ byang khog tu mi'i skye ba zhig len rgyu yin/ de'i nang nas kyang bla ma zhig yong rgyu yin gsungs byung bas/ de ma thag bdag gis de ltar na ma cig bka' drin can khyed rang gi mchod gzhis sogs kyang bdag gis ma 'thor ba byed sogs zhus pa snyam byed pa na gnyid sad byung pas dga' ba dang skyo ba zung 'brel gyi ngang nas/ slar de'i don la bsams pas 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi lung bstan byung nas mi lus thob rgyu yin sogs gsungs byung ba de ni bdag gi bla ma 'brel tshad don ldan 'di nyid kyis bka' drin 'khor med kyi ma gcig nyid la lam ston mdzad dus/

spyir mi lus thob pa dang / lhag par bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur zhes lung bstan gnang bar the tshom dang yid gnyis mi dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes khyad par can shar zhing / rgyu mtshan des na rje bla ma mus pa chen po buddha'i mtshan can 'di nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid slar yang sems can gyi don du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gzugs su bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa la yid gnyis dang bral ba'i nges pa'i shes pa yang dag pa rnyed nas/ bdud las kyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po bcos ma ma yin pa thob pa yin no/ /de ltar kho bo cag gis nges shes rnyed pa tsam du'ang ma zad rje dam pa rang nyid kyis kyang de bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes par snang ste/ kho bo cag rje nyid kyi zhabs drung du slebs nas gling dga' bde ba can gyi gdan sar bkod pa gnang ba'i nyin tshogs dbur phyin pa 'khor nas zhabs drung du slebs pas/ rje'i gsung las da lam tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel yod pas khyed bla ma na rim gyis gzim mal du sdod/ nged gdan srab pa 'di la sdod pa yin gsungs byung ba la/ bdag shin tu sems mdzangs pas ma nus pa na rje nyid kyi phyag gis bdag gi lag pa nas bsdud par mdzad de skyel ba gnang byung zhing / gzhan yang der skabs dad ldan gyi slob ma mang po dang bcas shin tu dges pa'i ngang nas gsung gleng rgyun ring byung bas rje'i gsung las/ da lam 'dir 'tshogs pa'i rang re dpon slob rnams sngon rje sems dpa' chen po la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gsung chos kyi bka' drin thob pa'i gang zag kyang yin no gsungs byung pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la sngon 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du bde kye gsang gsum sogs kyi dbang khrid man ngag mang du gsan 'dug pas/ nged rang gi rmi lam dang mthun par rje bla ma 'di nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam par sprul par zhal gyis bzhes par 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes dung dung pa shar zhing /

gzhan yang rje nyid phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab kyi nang nas rje 'jam dbyangs nyid kyi gsung rab rnams la mchog tu bstod bkur bsngags gsum mdzad pa zhig 'dug pa dang / gzhan yang bdag gis brtsams pa'i gling dga'i bca' yig na/ mgon khyod dang por kun mkhyen rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bar du sa bcu'i byang sems buddha'i mtshan/ /dus 'dir dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /kun gyi 'gran zla bral la kun nas dad/ /ces dang yang de'i sbyar byang du zhes gling dga' bde ba can chos grwa chen po'i bca' yig mdor bsdus 'di ni/ sa bcu'i byang sems chen po buddha ratna'i rnam par sprul pa rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes sogs bris pa dang / yang gsung ngag rin po che'i chos 'byung don gnyer dga' ba bskyed byed ces bya bar/ de ltar rje btsun sa bcu'i byang sems che/ /buddha ratna'i mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /bdag gi byang chub bar gyi skyabs de las/ /zhes bris pa'i yi ge rnams rje nyid kyi spyan lam du phab pa na/ spyir rje bla ma 'di nyid yon tan thams cad sba bar mdzad pas zhabs drung du bstod bkur dang bsngags pa brjod pa la shin tu mi mnyes pa zhig yin na'ang / gong du bkod pa'i yi ge'i tshul de dag gzigs pa'i tshe/ kho bo ni de lta bu'i sa bcu'i byang sems kyi sprul pa ma yin zhes bka' mi stsol ba sogs rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas/ rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid sa bcu'i byang sems chen po buddha ratna'i rnam par sprul par gdon mi za bar grub pa yin zhing / rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas nyid sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin pa'i tshul ni/

sngon mkhan chen gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i drung du rje byams pa chos 'od bzhugs pa'i skabs mkhan chen gyi gsung las/ nged kyi gdan sa 'di byang chub kyi sems rgyud la yod pa zhig gis bya dgos pa las/ da res byams pa chos 'od la babs so zhes gsungs byung bas/ rje byams pa chos 'od kyi dgongs pa la nged 'dir gdan sa byas na ni 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng bas mi tshe stong zad du 'gro ba 'dug cing / ma byas na bla ma'i dgongs pa ma bsgrub par 'gro bar 'dug pas/ de bas na da lta mus kyi gling dga' na rje sems dpa' chen por grags pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can zhig bzhugs yod 'dug pas de'i drung du 'gro dgos par 'dug dgongs 'byon par bzhed nas glo bur gshegs te/ rje sems dpa' chen po dang mjal nas bdag la bde kye gsang gsum sogs sa skya pa'i yab chos rnams gnang dgos tshul zhus pas/ khyed la las 'brel bzhag pa'i lha yin pas/ chos gzhan las snyung gnas rang zab pas dben gnas yo mor song la snyung gnas kho na gyis gsungs byung pa bzhin thugs dam gyi mthil snyung gnas la mdzad pas/ ring por ma thogs par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du zhal gzigs te/ de nas bzung ste 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gsung gleng rgyun mi chad pa mdzad pa la sogs pa yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba la brten spyan ras gzigs byams pa chos 'od ces grags pa yin zhing / de lta bu'i skyes bu dam pa de la 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen nyid kyis snyung gnas kyi chos skor rnams dang / don zhags rgyud chung gi lung sogs gsan nas bla mar bsten par mdzad pa las/ skabs shig gi tshe na sngar 'phros sogs med par rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis gsang thabs su mjal bar 'byon par mdzad pa na/ de'i tho rangs rje byams pa chos 'od pa'i drung du spyan ras gzigs 'od dang 'od zer 'phro bzhin pa dang bcas byon byung nas/

khyod kyi drung du de ring sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig 'byon pa yod pas phyag dang sna len bzang po gyis gsungs pa'i lung bstan byung pas/ rje byams pa chos 'od pas snga mor bzhengs nas so yang yang mdzad pas/ 'byon mkhan gang yang ma byung zhing / de nas phyi dro'i cha la babs pa na thugs the tshom du gyur nas dgon pa'i mdo na mna~X ltara~X zhig yod pa der byon nas bsgugs pas de ma thag rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpon slob rnams byon byung ba na sngar rje nyid phyag lan sogs mi mdzad yod pa la der skabs rje 'jam dbyangs kyi phyag 'bul gong rje nyid kyis phyag mdzad pas/ rje 'jam dbyangs nyid thugs bag tsha ba'i rnam pas de ltar mi mdzad pa zhu zhus pas/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ 'di bzhin byed dgos pa nged rang la yi dam lha'i lung bstan zhig byung bas cang mi sto ba lags zhes gsungs par grags so/ /rgyu mtshan des na 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po nyid sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen por gdon mi za ba'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa dang ldan par go bar bya'o/ /de ltar na bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa 'gran zla dang bral ba 'di nyid sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang sems chen po buddha ratna'i mtshan dang dbyer med par bzhugs pa gong du bshad pa ltar don la gnas/ de'i phyir bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas yon tan gyi tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu la dbang 'byor pas sku tshe 'dir thos bsam gyi bslab sbyangs sogs la ltos pa ni ga la zhig ste/ de ltar na yang so so skye bo rnams kha drang ba'i phyir dang gdul bya'i skye bo rnams kyi bsam pa dang / khams dang / bag la nyal dang 'tshams par chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor te smin grol lam la 'god pa'i phyir bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'dis thog mar yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams las sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin sogs gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par mdzad pa'i tshul mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig brjod na/

rje 'di dgung lo bcu gnyis su phebs pa bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi lo gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon par byon nas/ chos kyi rje mdog lho mkhan po dpal ldan rin chen pa'i drung du bstan pa'i rtsa ba yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes te mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar gsol zhing / rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs la'ang gnas par mdzad nas rten de la rje dpal shrī bhū ti ratna yin lags mgon rin chen pa gnas kyi slob dpon du bsten te gling dga' dgon pa'i sgrigs dang mthun pa'i kun spyod dang thos bsam rim par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ sa skya pa gong ma lnga dang rje ngor pa yab sras sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bstod tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / bzang spyod sogs smon lam gyi rigs mang po dang / bde kye gnyis kyi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud sogs dang / gzhan yang bde kye gsang gsum/ rdo rje phur pa/ kun rig tshe dpag med sogs sgrub dkyil gyi tshogs du ma/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i spyi ṭika kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa/ dag ljon spyi gsum sogs dri ma med pa'i gsung rab rnams la bslab sbyangs tshul bzhin du mdzad pa na/ sku tshe du mar goms pa lhur mdzad pa'i bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis gzhung lugs gang la yang brda bstan pa tsam gyis tshig don gnyis ka thogs med du mkhyen pa sogs mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pa gzhan las phul du byung bas skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur pa yin la/ gzhan yang kye rdor skor la kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun/ ṭikka gur rgyan/ gnad kyi gsal byed/ gzhung bshad snyag ma/ sras don ma/ dbang chu chen mo/ kun mkhyen gyi man ngag rnam bshad/ bde chen bcud snying / bde chen rgya mtsho/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi khrid yig mdzes rgyan rnam gnyis/ dbang bshad chen mo sogs dang / bde mchog skor la/

nag po rnam bshad chen mo/ lu hi pa'i rnam bshad chen mo dpag bsam ljon pa/ dril bu pa'i rnam bshad/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnam bshad/ rim bzhi lam slong / nag po dkyil chog nag po bshad sbyar/ lu hi pa'i 'bru 'bum chen mo/ rtsa rgyud kyi ṭikka mu tig phreng ba/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi ṭikka sogs dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la/ de'i rgyud dang rgya gzhung mang po/ gsang 'dus rnam bshad/ stong thun chen mo sogs yig cha mang po dang / yo ga'i skor la/ rnam bshad chen mo dpag bsam ljon pa/ gzhan phan skor gsum/ kun mkhyen gyi sbyong rgyud ṭikka/ gzhan phan gnod 'joms/ rje rdo rje'i 'chang gi bya spyod spyi rnam sogs/ bde kye gsang gsum/ yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i rgyud rgya gzhung / man ngag gzhung phran dang bcas pa'i yig cha mtha' dag thugs su tshud par mdzad de/ rje btsun dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i drung du shog bu mda' tshad la nye ba stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam zhig dus gcig la rgyugs 'bul mdzad pas/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gsung gis dus kyi tha ma 'di 'dra la shes rab dang rtsol ba dpe bral de lta bu gang las kyang ngo mtshar che zhes pa'i bstod bkur bsngags gsum du ma dang bcas zang zing gi gnang sbyin rgya chen po stsal cing mnyes pa rab kyi mthar son pa mdzad ces rje nyid kyi gsung las dngos su thos la/ gzhan yang 'dul ba dang / mngon pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / dbu ma sogs kyi gsung rab mtha' dag la yang sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad pa yin te/ phyis gzhung lugs de dag la mkhas par grags pa'i skyes bu du ma zhabs drung du lhags pa na/ gzhung lugs de dag gi dka' ba'i gnad rnams la dogs dpyod zhus pa'i tshe/ 'di dang 'di'o zhes rgyas bshad don bsdus dang bcas bka' stsal pa na mkhas pa chen po de dag gi gsung las/ rje 'di ni gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa zhig yin mod/

gzhung lugs mtha' dag la sbyangs tshul rang cher ma bstan to snyam yang / bdag nyid chen po 'di ni bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bshes gnyen mkhas pa sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa zhig 'dug ces smra'o/ /de ltar gzhung lugs rab 'byams de rnams kyi tshig don rnams dka' tshegs med par me long dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan bkra ba ltar/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i thugs la gsal bar smin te/ rigs pa dang mi rigs pa'i tshul rnam par 'byed pa la smra ba'i khyu mchog chen por gyur pa yin no/ /de nas rje 'di dgung lo nyi shur phebs pa drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo gsar du shar ba na dam pa 'dis srid pa'i phun tshogs thams cad rmi lam ltar snying po med cing bslu ba'i chos can kho nar sku tshe dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas gzigs te 'bras bu mngon du mdzad zin kyang / gzhan ngor nges legs don du gnyer ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba khyim gyi 'chings ba dug can gyi zas bzhin du spangs te bstan pa rin po che'i sgor 'jug dgos shing / de yang zhugs la yongs su rdzogs pa ni dge slong gi dngos po nyid yin pas de'i sdom pa nges par len dgos so/ /zhes bstan pa'i phyir du lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi 'dren mchog dam pa rje btsun dkon mchog rgya mtsho ba'i drung du mkhan po zhus shing / las kyi slob dpon sa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun chos dbang phyug pa dang / gsang ston slob dpon grub chen rin chen bzang po/ grib tshod pa rje tshul khrims 'od zer/ grogs dan pa dge slong nam mkha' rnam rgyal bas mdzad de dge 'dun bcu phrag gsum lhag tsam gyi dbus su tshigs gsum rim pa can gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob par mdzad de tshul khrims kyi phung po mig 'bras ltar gces par 'dzin pa mdzad pa yin la/

yang mkhan slob mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de dag las so so'i cho ga las thob pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nod par bzhed nas snga phyir brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed sogs byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa rnam par dag pas thugs rgyud btams par mdzad de/ byang sems kyi bslab bya mtha' dag thugs nyams su bzhes te nyes ltung cung zad tsam gyis kyang ma gos pa'i sems dpa' chen por bzhugs shing / yang rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ gong gi mkhan slob de gnyis sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du ma las/ rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su dbang dus su thob par gsungs pa'i sdom pa'i bka' drin mang du nod par mdzad nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos shing / tha mal gyi rnam rtog gang gis kyang brdzi bar mi nus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la dbang 'byor pa zhig ste/ mdor na so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa gsum la nyes pa cung zad tsam gyis kyang ma gos par btsun pa'i tshad du bzhugs pa'i tshul ni gong du mdo tsam bshad pa ltar yin la/ de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid gsum ldan gyi dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par bzhugs nas/ brgyud pa rnam par dag pa las 'ongs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ bdag cag gi bla ma 'dis 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag sa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dges pa rdo rje bka' babs bzhi'i dbang / gsang 'dus rigs gsum/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang sogs smin byed dbang gi rnam grangs bcu phrag gsum tsam dang /

gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo'i khrid cha lag yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa dang / de dag gi rgyab chos lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs kyi lung / gsung ngag glegs bam dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung / pod dmar ma dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung sogs lung gi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing / yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor la/ nag po rim bzhi'i khrid/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid/ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe khrid sogs dang / de dag dang sgo 'brel ba'i chos skor la/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / nag po gzhung drug dril bu gzhung gsum sogs yig cha mang po'i lung dang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ de'i rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung tshad ldan mang po dang / bde mchog skor gyi khrid yig mang po'i lung sogs gsan to/ /yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rim lnga'i khrid dang 'di'i rgyud dang rgya gzhung tshad ldan 'phags pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang / bod gzhung rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa sogs gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag gzhung phran dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa gsan nas thugs su tshud pa mdzad la/ gzhan yang dam pa de nyid kyi drung du gshed dmar spros med kyi dmigs khrid yig cha du ma'i lung dang bcas pa/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi bshad lung sogs yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i rgyud sde du ma'i bshad lung dang / gzhan phan skor gsum/ kun mkhyen gyi gzhan phan gnod 'joms sogs dang / rdo rje 'chang gi bya spyod spyi rnam gyi bshad lung sogs rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bus thugs rgyud btams par mdzad la/ yang theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral dang / blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid sogs blo sbyongs gi zab khrid du ma dang / bka' gdams pha chos bu chos kyi lung sogs blo sbyongs gi chos bskor yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan pa yin la/

gzhan yang rje 'di sku gzhon nu'i dus paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug pa'i drung du bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid dang rjes gnang / bka' gdams gzhung drug sogs yig cha mang po'i lung dang bcas pa gsan nas/ mdor na bka' gdams bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por yang gyur pa yin no/ /yang rje btsun dam pa ratna'i mtshan can de nyid kyi drung du/ grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor gyi zab chos ne gu chos drug gi khrid byin rlabs so so dang bcas pa/ phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid dang byin rlabs/ de dag gi rgyab chos kyi yig cha yod do cog gi lung dang bcas pa ma tshangs ba med par gsan nas brtson 'grus drag pos thugs nyams su bzhes pa la brten nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / rmi lam gyi grub thob chen por gyur pa'i tshul sogs gong du zur tsam bshad pa ltar yin la/ yang rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i drung du mgon po'i rtsa gsum 'khor lo la brten pa'i khrid dang / de'i yig cha mang po'i lung dang bcas pa dang / rjes gnang gi skor la/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho ste rjes gnang gi bka' srol chen po gnyis dang / zur bka' bcu phrag gsum gyis lhag pa so so'i yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang lung gi skor la/ rje sa chen gyi bka' 'bum phal cher gyi lung / rje rdo rje 'chang sogs bstan 'dzin tshad ldan rnams kyi gsung 'bum phal cher gyi lung / khyad par rje sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung sogs lung gi rigs bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gsan pa yin no/ /yang bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'dis mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mnga' bdag tu gyur cing / lhag par dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa'i drung du dges pa rdo rje'i rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang lan grangs du ma sogs de skor gyi zab chos du ma zhig zhib cing mtha' chod pa gsan cing /

khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang dang khrid yongs rdzogs/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi khrid dang byin rlabs/ 'di la brten pa'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma sogs shin tu zab pa'i yang rtser gyur pa thams cad dang / de dag dang sgo 'brel ba'i bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud/ nag po gzhung drug lū hi pa'i smad lnga/ dril bu gzhung gsum sogs rgya gzhung tshad ldan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rje sa chen yab sras/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen chen po/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen sogs rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin yongs grags mang pos mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi bod gzhung tshad ldan bgrang bar dka' ba lta bu zhig gi lung dang bshad par bcas pa gsan pa yin la/ de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud dang rgya gzhung dbang khrid lung man ngag ma lus pa'i zab don gyi nor bus 'dren pa dam pa 'di'i thugs kyi rgya mtsho yongs su btams te/ zab khrid kyi snying po la rtse gcig tu mdzad pa la brten bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i lung bstan khyad par can brnyes pa'i tshul dang / sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes mngon du mdzad cing / ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lha'i mig gi mngon par mkhyen pa thob nas 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba len pa sogs thogs med du mkhyen pa dang / mkha' spyod ma'i 'da' ka ma zab mo'i rnal 'byor 'byongs pa rab gyi mthar son pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar can mig yod kun gyi mngon du gyur pa'i tshul sogs ni sngar bshad pa ltar yin no/ /gzhan yang rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi drung du yo ga'i rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa'i bshad pa lung dang bcas pa yang nos shing / rjes gnang gi skor la/ sgrol ma sogs bar chad zhi ba'i lha rnams dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs byang chub kyi sems rgyas pa'i lha du ma dang / sgrol dkar dang rnam rgyal sogs tshe rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang /
